summary: Attempted comprehensive testing of ResQTrack social media response system. Frontend loads correctly with disaster markers visible, but critical issue prevents disaster marker clicks from triggering sidebar updates and social media responses.

integration_issues.issue: Marker click events not triggering handleDisasterClick function
integration_issues.impact: Cannot access disaster details or social media responses

passed_tests: Frontend loads successfully with dark theme
Disaster markers visible on map (274 total disasters)
Statistics display correctly (5 severe, 27 moderate, 242 mild)
Social media code implementation verified in source
Username pool (300+ usernames) present in code
SocialFeed component implemented with proper styling
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix disaster marker click events. The handleDisasterClick function is not being triggered when markers are clicked, preventing access to disaster details and social media responses. This blocks testing of the entire social media response system.

success_percentage.frontend: 70% (core features work, but marker interaction broken)
success_percentage.integration: 0% (cannot test social media integration due to marker click issue)
